headline: Claude Code 2.1.314 بيضيف إعداد يمنع الكتابة برّه المشروع، وLaravel 13.39 بيكتب ملفات الـ cache بشكل atomic، وWarp أعلنت اختراق عند vendor كشف agent logs لحوالي 1% من المستخدمين.
headline_en: Claude Code 2.1.314 adds a setting that blocks writes outside the project, Laravel 13.39 writes cache files atomically, and Warp disclosed a vendor breach that exposed agent logs for about 1% of users.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.314: إعداد يمنع الكتابة برّه مجلد الشغل، وإصلاح تعارض index.lock
items.summary: إصدار 2.1.314 نزل يوم 30 أكتوبر (مفيش 2.1.313). ضاف إعداد permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories اللي بيمنع Write وEdit من الكتابة برّه مجلدات الشغل في كل أوضاع الصلاحيات، وصلّح مشكلة إن git يفشل بـ index.lock، وclaude -p بقى يطلع error وexit 1 لو البداية فشلت.
items.why: لو بتشغّل Claude Code على ريبو الـ ERP جنب lazygit أو أوامر git، إصلاح index.lock هيريّحك. وفعّل الإعداد الجديد في settings.json عشان الـ agent ما يلمسش ملفات برّه المشروع زي docker-compose في مجلدات تانية.
items.about:
إصدار 2.1.314 نزل على npm يوم 30 أكتوبر، والـ CHANGELOG بينقل من 2.1.312 لـ 2.1.314 على طول.

الجديد: إعداد permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories بيخلي Write وEdit وNotebookEdit يرفضوا أي مسار برّه مجلدات الشغل، في كل أوضاع الصلاحيات. واتضاف idle compaction لـ VS Code وتاب Code في Claude Desktop: المحادثة اللي فوق 200K token لو سبتها والـ prompt cache خلص، بتتلخص ويتبعت الملخص مع رسالتك الجاية.

أهم الإصلاحات: الـ diff refresh في الخلفية كان بياخد .git/index.lock لحظة فأوامر git اللي بتشتغل في نفس الوقت تفشل بـ "Unable to create '.git/index.lock': File exists". وclaude -p كان بيخرج بكود 0 من غير أي output لو البداية فشلت، دلوقتي بيطبع الخطأ ويخرج بـ 1، وده مهم لأي script أو CI. وhooks الـ Bash بقت بتشتغل على الأوامر اللي أداة Monitor بتبدأها، وoutput الـ PreCompact hook بقى بيتقص عند 10,000 حرف.

وكمان: لو الأدمن حاطط حد للـ effort، Claude Code بقى بينزّل المستوى ويكمّل بدل ما يفشل بـ "Invalid effort level"، وإصلاح لصق الصور على SSH لجهاز Linux اللي كان بيفشل في صمت.
features: إعداد blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories يمنع الكتابة برّه المشروع
إصلاح فشل git بسبب .git/index.lock
claude -p بيرجع exit 1 ورسالة خطأ لو البداية فشلت
hooks الـ Bash بتشتغل على أوامر Monitor
idle compaction للمحادثات الطويلة في VS Code وDesktop

en.title: Claude Code v2.1.314: a setting that blocks writes outside the working directory, and an index.lock fix
en.summary: Version 2.1.314 shipped on October 30 (there is no 2.1.313). It adds permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories, which stops Write and Edit from writing outside the working directories in every permission mode, fixes git failing on index.lock, and makes claude -p print an error and exit 1 when startup fails.
en.why: If you run Claude Code on the ERP repo alongside lazygit or git commands, the index.lock fix will save you some friction. Turn on the new setting in settings.json so the agent can't touch files outside the project, like docker-compose files in other folders.
en.about:
Version 2.1.314 was published to npm on October 30, and the CHANGELOG goes straight from 2.1.312 to 2.1.314.

New: the permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories setting makes Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse any path outside the working directories, in every permission mode. Idle compaction was added to VS Code and the Code tab in Claude Desktop: a conversation over 200K tokens that you leave idle until the prompt cache expires is summarized, and the summary is sent with your next message.

The main fixes: background diff refreshes briefly took .git/index.lock, so git commands running at the same moment failed with "Unable to create '.git/index.lock': File exists". claude -p used to exit with code 0 and no output when startup failed; it now prints the error and exits 1, which matters for any script or CI job. Bash hooks now run on commands started by the Monitor tool, and PreCompact hook output is cut at 10,000 characters.

Also: when an admin caps a model's effort, Claude Code now lowers the level and carries on instead of failing with "Invalid effort level", and pasting an image over SSH to a Linux machine no longer fails silently.
features: blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories setting blocks writes outside the project
Fix for git failing on .git/index.lock
claude -p returns exit 1 and an error message when startup fails
Bash hooks run on Monitor commands
Idle compaction for long conversations in VS Code and Desktop

items.title: Claude API: Usage and Cost Analytics API (beta) وحجم الطلب بقى 128 MB
items.summary: يوم 29 أكتوبر نزل Usage and Cost Analytics API في beta بـ endpoints جديدة للاستهلاك والتكلفة، تقدر تقسمها حسب الموديل والـ workspace والـ API key والمستخدم. ويوم 28 أكتوبر الحد الأقصى لحجم الطلب في Messages API وToken Counting API اتنقل من 32 MB لـ 128 MB.
items.why: لو بتربط الـ ERP بـ Claude API، تقدر تسحب تكلفة كل API key أو workspace أوتوماتيك وتعمل تقرير شهري بدل ما تفتح الـ Console. والـ 128 MB بتسمح بإرسال PDFs وصور أكبر في طلب واحد.
items.about:
الـ endpoints الجديدة هي /v1/organizations/analytics/usage و/v1/organizations/analytics/cost، وبتحتاج الـ beta header analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24. بتغطي منظمات Claude Console وClaude Enterprise، وتقدر تفلتر وتجمّع النتايج حسب الموديل والـ workspace والـ API key والمستخدم أو الـ service account اللي عمل الطلب.

الـ Usage and Cost API القديم بقى legacy، وكذلك endpoints التقارير في Enterprise Analytics API (usage_report وcost_report وuser_usage_report وuser_cost_report). لسه شغالين ومدعومين، وفيه أدلة migration في الـ release notes.

وفي تغيير منفصل يوم 28 أكتوبر: الحد الأقصى لحجم الطلب على Claude API المباشر (مش عن طريق cloud providers) بقى 128 MB بدل 32 MB، للـ Messages API والـ Token Counting API.
features: endpoints للاستهلاك والتكلفة على مستوى المنظمة
تجميع حسب الموديل والـ workspace والـ API key والمستخدم

en.title: Claude API: Usage and Cost Analytics API (beta), and requests can now be 128 MB
en.summary: On October 29 the Usage and Cost Analytics API launched in beta with new usage and cost endpoints you can break down by model, workspace, API key and user. On October 28 the maximum request size for the Messages API and Token Counting API went from 32 MB to 128 MB.
en.why: If you connect the ERP to the Claude API, you can pull the cost of each API key or workspace automatically and build a monthly report instead of opening the Console. And 128 MB lets you send bigger PDFs and images in a single request.
en.about:
The new endpoints are /v1/organizations/analytics/usage and /v1/organizations/analytics/cost, and they need the beta header analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24. They cover Claude Console and Claude Enterprise organizations, and you can filter and group results by model, workspace, API key, and the user or service account behind each request.

The old Usage and Cost API is now legacy, as are the report endpoints of the Enterprise Analytics API (usage_report, cost_report, user_usage_report and user_cost_report). They still work and are supported, and the release notes link migration guides.

In a separate change on October 28, the maximum request size on the first-party Claude API (not through cloud providers) went to 128 MB from 32 MB, for both the Messages API and the Token Counting API.
features: Organization-level usage and cost endpoints
Grouping by model, workspace, API key and user
The old API is legacy but still supported
Requests up to 128 MB instead of 32 MB

items.title: Laravel 13.39: أمر session:garbage-collect، وmodels من غير primary key، وكتابة atomic لملفات الـ cache
items.summary: Laravel 13.39 نزل يوم 28 أكتوبر. فيه أمر Artisan جديد session:garbage-collect تجدوله بدل التنظيف العشوائي مع الطلبات، وmodels من غير primary key بـ #[Table(key: false)]، وduration على JobAttempted، وconfig:cache وroute:cache وevent:cache بقوا بيكتبوا الملف atomic.
items.why: في الـ ERP على Docker مع PHP-FPM، الكتابة الـ atomic لملفات الـ cache بتمنع إن طلب يقرا ملف config فاضي أثناء الـ deploy. وجدول تنظيف الـ sessions لو بتستخدم database driver، واستخدم duration في مراقبة الـ jobs.
items.about:
أمر session:garbage-collect بيشغّل الـ garbage collector بتاع الـ session driver وبيعتمد على session.lifetime. تقدر تجدوله ساعة بساعة، وتوقف التنظيف العشوائي مع الطلبات بإنك تخلي lottery في config/session.php = [0, 100].

الـ models من غير key: #[Table(name: 'activity_log', key: false)] بيلغي الـ primary key، وتصليح تاني خلّاها non-incrementing عشان create() ما يرميش exception. ده مفيد لجداول اللوج والـ pivot. وJobAttempted بقى فيه duration بالمللي ثانية، وRule::array() بقى فيه min وmax وbetween وexactly.

أوامر config:cache وroute:cache وevent:cache بقت بتكتب في ملف مؤقت وبعدين تعمل rename، فمفيش طلب يقرا ملف cache فاضي أثناء الكتابة. وفي الـ testing: attribute جديد #[WithoutMigrationEvents]، والـ Mail fake بقى بيتعامل مع Mail::html() وMail::plain() اللي كانوا بيبعتوا إيميل حقيقي في التيستات، وRefreshDatabase بيعمل rollback لكل مستويات الـ transactions.

وفيه BelongsToMany::forceCreate()، وrestoreOrCreate() شغال من خلال العلاقات، وفي الـ filesystem checks بقى phar:// ممنوع.
features: أمر session:garbage-collect للجدولة
Eloquent models من غير primary key
duration بالمللي ثانية على JobAttempted
كتابة atomic لملفات config وroute وevent cache
Mail fake بيمسك Mail::html() وMail::plain()

en.title: Laravel 13.39: a session:garbage-collect command, keyless models and atomic cache file writes
en.summary: Laravel 13.39 shipped on October 28. It adds a session:garbage-collect Artisan command you schedule instead of random cleanup on requests, keyless models with #[Table(key: false)], a duration on JobAttempted, and atomic writes for config:cache, route:cache and event:cache.
en.why: For the ERP on Docker with PHP-FPM, atomic cache writes stop a request from reading an empty config file during a deploy. Schedule session cleanup if you use the database driver, and use duration in your job monitoring.
en.about:
The session:garbage-collect command runs the session driver's garbage collector and relies on session.lifetime. You can schedule it hourly and stop random cleanup on requests by setting lottery in config/session.php to [0, 100].

Keyless models: #[Table(name: 'activity_log', key: false)] removes the primary key, and a follow-up fix makes these models non-incrementing so create() doesn't throw. This is useful for log and pivot tables. JobAttempted now has a duration in milliseconds, and Rule::array() gains min, max, between and exactly.

config:cache, route:cache and event:cache now write to a temporary file and then rename it, so no request reads an empty cache file mid-write. In testing: a new #[WithoutMigrationEvents] attribute, the Mail fake now handles Mail::html() and Mail::plain(), which used to send real email during tests, and RefreshDatabase rolls back every open transaction level.

There is also BelongsToMany::forceCreate(), restoreOrCreate() works through relationships, and phar:// is now blocked in filesystem checks.
features: A session:garbage-collect command to schedule
Eloquent models without a primary key
Duration in milliseconds on JobAttempted
Atomic writes for config, route and event cache files
The Mail fake catches Mail::html() and Mail::plain()

items.title: Laravel Boost v2.10.4: أداة application-info اتشالت والـ skills اتظبطت
items.summary: Boost 2.10.4 نزل يوم 29 أكتوبر. شال أداة application-info من الـ MCP server، وضاف أمر لإعادة فهرسة الـ rules، وسمح بـ Pest 5، وشال تعليمة "شغّل كل التيستات" من guideline بتاع Pest، وخلّى اقتراح composer run dev يظهر بس لو التطبيق فيه dev script.
items.why: لو عندك prompts أو CLAUDE.md في الـ ERP بتطلب من الـ agent يستخدم application-info، هتلاقيها مش موجودة بعد التحديث، فعدّلها. وتعليمة تشغيل كل التيستات اتشالت، فالـ agent هيشغّل اللي يخص التعديل بس.
items.about:
Laravel Boost هو الـ MCP server والـ guidelines الرسمية اللي بتدي الـ coding agents سياق عن تطبيق Laravel بتاعك.

في 2.10.4: أداة application-info اتشالت من الـ MCP (#1074)، واتضاف أمر لإعادة فهرسة الـ rules (#1062)، والـ testing skill بقى يسمح للـ unit tests إنها تعمل extend لـ TestCase بتاع PHPUnit (#1065)، وصياغة الـ skills اتشدّت (#1076).

كمان: اقتراح composer run dev بيظهر بس للتطبيقات اللي فيها dev script (#1083)، والـ scripts بتاعة الـ remote skills بتحافظ على صلاحية التنفيذ (#1082)، وتعليمة تشغيل الـ suite كلها اتشالت من guideline بتاع Pest (#1084)، وPest 5 بقى مسموح في dev dependencies (#1078).

ملحوظة: تفاصيل الإصدار هنا من release notes المنقولة، واسم أمر إعادة الفهرسة مش مذكور، فراجع صفحة الإصدار قبل ما تستخدمه.
features: أداة application-info اتشالت من الـ MCP
أمر جديد لإعادة فهرسة الـ rules
دعم Pest 5
guideline بتاع Pest ما بقاش بيطلب تشغيل كل التيستات

en.title: Laravel Boost v2.10.4: the application-info tool is gone and the skills were tightened
en.summary: Boost 2.10.4 shipped on October 29. It removes the application-info tool from the MCP server, adds a command to re-index rules, allows Pest 5, drops the "run the full suite" instruction from the Pest guideline, and only suggests composer run dev when the app has a dev script.
en.why: If prompts or the CLAUDE.md in the ERP ask the agent to use application-info, it won't be there after the update, so edit them. And with the run-everything instruction gone, the agent will run only the tests related to the change.
en.about:
Laravel Boost is the official MCP server and guidelines that give coding agents context about your Laravel app.

In 2.10.4: the application-info tool was removed from the MCP (#1074), a command to re-index rules was added (#1062), the testing skill now lets unit tests extend PHPUnit's TestCase (#1065), and the skills' wording was tightened (#1076).

Also: the composer run dev suggestion only appears for apps that define a dev script (#1083), remote skill scripts keep their executable permission (#1082), the instruction to run the whole suite was removed from the Pest guideline (#1084), and Pest 5 is allowed in dev dependencies (#1078).

Note: these details come from relayed release notes, and the re-index command's name isn't given, so check the release page before using it.
features: The application-info tool was removed from the MCP
A new command to re-index rules
Pest 5 support
The Pest guideline no longer asks to run the whole suite

items.title: Warp بتعلن اختراق عند vendor خارجي كشف agent logs وtelemetry
items.summary: Warp أعلنت يوم 27 أكتوبر إن vendor خارجي في البنية بتاعتها اتخترق، وده كشف agent traces (سجلات قرارات الـ agent) وبيانات telemetry. الـ CEO قال إن حوالي 1% من المستخدمين ممكن يكونوا اتأثروا واتبلغوا، ولسه ما اتقالش هل الـ prompts أو الكود أو الـ credentials كانوا من ضمن البيانات.
items.why: إنت شغال في Warp كل يوم ومعاه Claude Code، فشوف إيميلك لو جالك إشعار، وراجع أي secrets ظهرت في جلسات agents جوه Warp وغيّرها لو لزم، وخلي بالك من أي رسايل غريبة بتدّعي إنها من Warp.
items.about:
حسب BleepingComputer، الـ CEO زاك لويد قال إن الشركة لاحظت النشاط يوم الجمعة، واكتشفته في خلال ساعات وقفلته. الهجوم كان على vendor خارجي ما اتعلنش اسمه، والتحليل بيقول إنه استخدم "agent swarm" وأسلوب اختراق وتصعيد متطور.

البيانات اللي اتكشفت: agent traces وtelemetry. Warp ما وضّحتش لحد دلوقتي هل فيها كود أو prompts أو credentials. التقدير إن حوالي 1% من المستخدمين اتأثروا، واتبعتلهم إشعارات.

Warp جابت CrowdStrike للتحقيق وبلّغت الجهات القانونية. النصيحة للمستخدمين: راقب نشاط حسابك، وخلي بالك من الرسايل اللي مش متوقعة. مفيش تحديث للتطبيق مرتبط بالحادثة.
features: الاختراق عند vendor خارجي مش في Warp نفسها
اتكشفت agent traces وtelemetry
حوالي 1% من المستخدمين واتبلغوا
CrowdStrike بتحقق في الحادثة

en.title: Warp discloses a breach at a third-party vendor that exposed agent logs and telemetry
en.summary: Warp disclosed on October 27 that a third-party vendor in its infrastructure was breached, exposing agent traces (agent decision logs) and telemetry data. The CEO said roughly 1% of users may have been affected and were notified, and it hasn't been said whether prompts, code or credentials were included.
en.why: You work in Warp every day alongside Claude Code, so check your email for a notice, review any secrets that showed up in agent sessions inside Warp and rotate them if needed, and be wary of unexpected messages claiming to be from Warp.
en.about:
According to BleepingComputer, CEO Zach Lloyd said the company noticed the activity on Friday, detected it within hours and shut it down. The attack targeted an unnamed third-party vendor, and analysis suggests it used an "agent swarm" and a sophisticated penetration and escalation technique.

The exposed data: agent traces and telemetry. Warp has not yet said whether it included code, prompts or credentials. Roughly 1% of users are estimated to be affected, and they have been notified.

Warp brought in CrowdStrike to investigate and informed law enforcement. The advice to users: monitor your account activity and be careful with unexpected messages. There is no app update tied to the incident.
features: The breach was at a third-party vendor, not Warp itself
Agent traces and telemetry were exposed
About 1% of users, who were notified
CrowdStrike is investigating

items.title: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles متاحة للكل: ثبّت الـ actions على commit محدد
items.summary: من 28 أكتوبر بقى ممكن تحط ملف .github/workflows/actions.lock يثبّت كل action والـ dependencies بتاعتها على commit محدد، حتى لو الـ tag اتحرك. بيتعمل بـ extension اسمها gh actions-lock، وDependabot بيحدّثه في نفس الـ PR، والأدمن يقدر يفرضه بـ policy. متاح على Free وTeam وEnterprise Cloud.
items.why: لو الـ ERP بيتعمله build أو deploy بـ GitHub Actions، ده بيقفل باب إن action مشهور يتخترق ويتغيّر الـ tag بتاعه فتسحب كود خبيث في الـ pipeline. ابدأ بـ workflow الـ deploy لوحده.
items.about:
الـ lockfile اسمه .github/workflows/actions.lock، وبيسجّل الـ commit بالظبط لكل action والـ dependencies اللي تحتها. الـ workflows نفسها بتفضل مكتوبة بالـ tags المقروءة زي v4، بس Actions بيشغّل الـ commit المسجّل في الـ lockfile.

بتعمل الملف بـ extension لـ GitHub CLI اسمها gh actions-lock من ريبو github/gh-actions-lock، وبعدين تراجعه وتعمله commit. تقدر تضيف workflows واحد واحد، بس كل dependency في workflow مضاف لازم تكون في الـ lockfile. Dependabot لما يفتح PR لتحديث action بيحدّث الـ lockfile في نفس الـ PR من غير إعداد إضافي، وتقدر تتأكد إن الملف مش قديم في الـ CI من غير ما يتعدّل.

الأدمن على مستوى الـ enterprise أو الـ org أو الريبو يقدر يفعّل policy اسمها "Require lockfile". وGitHub بتنبّه إن الـ lockfile بيثبّت اللي بيشتغل بس ما بيحكمش إن الـ dependency آمنة، فراجعها قبل ما تقفلها.
features: ملف actions.lock بيثبّت الـ commit لكل action وdependencies بتاعته
الـ workflows تفضل بالـ tags المقروءة
Dependabot بيحدّث الـ lockfile في نفس الـ PR
policy اسمها Require lockfile للأدمن
فحص إن الملف محدّث جوه الـ CI
requirements: GitHub CLI مع extension الـ gh actions-lock

pricing.note: متاح على Free وTeam وEnterprise Cloud

en.title: GitHub Actions workflow lockfiles are generally available: pin actions to an exact commit
en.summary: Since October 28 you can add a .github/workflows/actions.lock file that pins every action and its dependencies to an exact commit, even if the tag moves. It's generated with the gh actions-lock extension, Dependabot updates it in the same PR, and admins can enforce it with a policy. Available on Free, Team and Enterprise Cloud.
en.why: If the ERP is built or deployed with GitHub Actions, this closes the door on a popular action being compromised and its tag moved so your pipeline pulls malicious code. Start with the deploy workflow alone.
en.about:
The lockfile is .github/workflows/actions.lock, and it records the exact commit of every action and the dependencies beneath it. The workflows themselves keep readable tags like v4, but Actions runs the commit recorded in the lockfile.

You generate the file with a GitHub CLI extension, gh actions-lock, from the github/gh-actions-lock repo, then review and commit it. You can onboard workflows one at a time, but every dependency of an onboarded workflow must be in the lockfile. When Dependabot opens a PR to update an action, it updates the lockfile in the same PR with no extra setup, and you can check that the file is current in CI without modifying it.

Admins at the enterprise, org or repo level can turn on a "Require lockfile" policy. GitHub notes that the lockfile only pins what runs and doesn't judge whether a dependency is safe, so review it before locking it.
features: An actions.lock file pins the commit of every action and its dependencies
Workflows keep readable tags
Dependabot updates the lockfile in the same PR
A Require lockfile policy for admins
A CI check that the file is current
requirements: GitHub CLI with the gh actions-lock extension
en.pricingNote: Available on Free, Team and Enterprise Cloud

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows متاحة للكل: automations بالـ Markdown بتتحول لـ Actions
items.summary: يوم 28 أكتوبر بقت GitHub Agentic Workflows متاحة للكل. بتكتب الـ automation بلغة طبيعية في ملف Markdown، وبيتحول لـ YAML عادي بتاع GitHub Actions، والـ agent بيشتغل read-only افتراضياً جوه sandbox وفيه job بيفحص التغييرات قبل ما تتطبق. متاحة على Free وTeam وEnterprise.
items.why: تقدر تعمل workflow يحلل فشل الـ CI في ريبو الـ ERP أو يفرز الـ issues من غير ما تكتب YAML طويل. خد بالك إن الـ engine الافتراضي Copilot CLI ومحتاج رخصة Copilot، وفيه خيار تجيب agent بتاعك.
items.about:

en.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows are generally available: Markdown automations that compile to Actions
en.summary: On October 28 GitHub Agentic Workflows became generally available. You write the automation in natural language in a Markdown file, it compiles to standard GitHub Actions YAML, and the agent runs read-only by default inside a sandbox, with a job that checks changes before they're applied. Available on Free, Team and Enterprise.
en.why: You can build a workflow that analyzes CI failures in the ERP repo or triages issues without writing long YAML. Note that the default engine is Copilot CLI and needs a Copilot license, and you can bring your own agent instead.
en.about:
It's an open source project from GitHub Next. You write the workflow as a Markdown file in plain language, it compiles to Actions YAML, so it uses the runners and policies you already have. The listed use cases: issue triage, CI failure analysis, documentation updates and test writing.

Security: read-only permissions by default, the agent runs in an isolated container behind the Agent Workflow Firewall, output goes through "safe outputs" checks, and a threat-detection job scans proposed changes before they're applied. There is also optional micro-VM isolation and support for self-hosted runners.

The CLI is a gh extension, gh aw, and gh aw forecast, which estimates AI cost, is no longer experimental. The default engine is Copilot CLI and needs a Copilot license, and you can pick another agent per workflow.

Read-only by default, sandboxed behind a firewall
A job that checks changes before they're applied

en.title: Copilot Fusion is generally available: Copilot picks the models and splits the work
en.summary: At GitHub Universe on October 28, Copilot Fusion became generally available: you pick Fusion and Copilot spreads the work across several models, with Standard, High and Max levels and Single, Cascade and Critique modes. GitHub says Fusion Max scored 60 on Artificial Analysis's Coding Agent Index at about half the cost. There is also experimental support for local models.
en.why: A useful comparison with the Claude Code you use: if someone on the team is on Copilot, Fusion gives close performance at lower cost by GitHub's own numbers. Routing to a local model could help with ERP code you don't want to send out, though the routing itself still happens in the cloud.
en.about:
Fusion routes requests and coordinates models for you. There are 3 effort levels, Standard, High and Max, and 3 modes: Single, Cascade (a draft from a cheap model that escalates to a stronger one if needed), and Critique (draft, then review, then revise). GitHub says Fusion Max scored 60 on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, "within two points of Claude Code with Opus 5.5 Max", at about half the cost and tokens per task. That figure comes from GitHub itself.

It's available on all Copilot plans in VS Code, the Copilot app, Copilot CLI and JetBrains. Billing is each model's standard rate, with a limited-time 30% discount on paid plans.

Local models (experimental): MAI Code 1.1 Flash through Windows ML on Windows only, or Qwen3.8 Flash Next on any local OpenAI-compatible server, and BYOK in the CLI works on Windows, macOS and Linux. The routing decision itself still happens in the cloud.

Same day: GitHub Enterprise now includes Copilot for every licensed user for account-team customers, with usage metered from the first request against the enterprise budget.

en.title: next-bundle-optimizer: an official Next.js skill that has your agent cut JavaScript size
en.summary: Next.js 16.4 ships a skill, next-bundle-optimizer, that gives the agent access to Turbopack's module graph so it can find imports that load heavy code early and suggest or apply fixes. Vercel says it cut about 2 MB of compressed JavaScript across v0 and vercel.com. next analyze also gains a route summary and snapshot comparison.
en.why: Run it in Claude Code on any Next.js project you have, Marsad included, to find heavy libraries loading on first paint. Start with the report before using fix.
en.about:
The skill uses the detailed module graph, so it needs Turbopack (the default bundler since Next.js 16) and Next.js 16.4.

It has the agent export next analyze snapshots as JSON, rebuild the module and chunk graphs, look for large groups of modules, trace their import chains, and use minimum cut to find the smallest set of import boundaries that would defer them. It also finds chances to move logic to React Server Components, duplicate copies of large dependencies, and cases where tree shaking didn't apply.

By default it reports problems and suggested fixes. /next-bundle-optimizer fix applies the changes, reruns the analysis and compares snapshots. For humans: next analyze now has a page of your largest routes, saved snapshots you can diff, a critical-render-path filter, and next analyze export dumps the graph as JSON.
features: Access to Turbopack's module graph

items.title: Supabase: OrioleDB في public beta وMultigres للـ HA في private alpha
items.summary: Supabase فتحت OrioleDB في public beta يوم 28 أكتوبر، وده storage engine مفتوح المصدر لـ Postgres بيقولوا إنه أسرع بحوالي 1.8x في الـ benchmark بتاعهم. ويوم 29 أكتوبر أعلنت Multigres في private alpha: طبقة high availability من فريق Vitess بـ 3 nodes وfailover في ثواني. الاتنين مش للـ production لسه.
items.why: لو بتفكر تنقل جزء من الـ ERP لـ Postgres أو Supabase، ده يستاهل تجربة على مشروع جانبي بس. الاتنين لازم يتختاروا وإنت بتعمل المشروع، ومفيش PITR، فما تحطش عليهم بيانات حقيقية.
items.about:
OrioleDB بيركب على Postgres عن طريق Table Access Method. الـ beta هي OrioleDB beta19 على Postgres 17.11، ومتاحة على كل خطط Supabase وبتتحسب زي Postgres العادي. Supabase بتقول إنها مش جاهزة للـ production: من غير SLA ومن غير Point-in-Time Recovery. لازم تختارها وإنت بتعمل المشروع، ومحلياً بـ supabase init --use-orioledb مع Supabase CLI 2.119.0 أو أحدث. CLUSTER وVACUUM FULL مش مدعومين، وHNSW بتاع pgvector شغال عن طريق bridge تجريبي. الرقم 1.8x جاي من benchmark بتاعهم على بيانات أكبر من الذاكرة.

Multigres طبقة HA مرخصة Apache-2.0 من الفريق اللي عمل Vitess، بتلف Postgres العادي من غير fork. cluster من 3 nodes على availability zones مختلفة، وconsensus فوق synchronous replication، وfailover في ثواني، وpooling مدمج لكل مستخدم.

Multigres للمنظمات اللي على خطة مدفوعة وبدعوة، ومجاني أثناء الـ alpha لحد مشروعين لكل منظمة. مش للـ production، ومن غير Realtime وPITR، وفي region واحدة (East US). والمشروع الواحد يا OrioleDB يا Multigres، مش الاتنين.

en.title: Supabase: OrioleDB in public beta and Multigres HA in private alpha
en.summary: Supabase opened OrioleDB in public beta on October 28, an open source storage engine for Postgres it says is about 1.8x faster in its own benchmark. On October 29 it announced Multigres in private alpha: a high availability layer from the Vitess team with 3 nodes and failover in seconds. Neither is for production yet.
en.why: If you're considering moving part of the ERP to Postgres or Supabase, these are worth trying on a side project only. Both must be chosen when you create the project and have no PITR, so don't put real data on them.
en.about:
OrioleDB plugs into Postgres through the Table Access Method interface. The beta is OrioleDB beta19 on Postgres 17.11, available on every Supabase plan and billed like standard Postgres. Supabase says it isn't production-ready: no SLA and no Point-in-Time Recovery. You choose it when creating the project, and locally with supabase init --use-orioledb on Supabase CLI 2.119.0 or later. CLUSTER and VACUUM FULL are unsupported, and pgvector HNSW works through an experimental bridge. The 1.8x figure comes from their benchmark on data larger than memory.

Multigres is an Apache-2.0 HA layer from the team that built Vitess, wrapping standard Postgres without a fork. A 3-node cluster across availability zones, consensus on top of synchronous replication, failover in seconds, and built-in per-user pooling.

Multigres is for organizations on a paid plan, by invitation, and free during the alpha for up to 2 projects per organization. It's not for production, has no Realtime or PITR, and runs in one region (East US). A project can use OrioleDB or Multigres, not both.
features: OrioleDB, an open source storage engine for Postgres 17
About 1.8x throughput in Supabase's benchmark
Multigres: 3-node HA with failover in seconds
Neither is for production, and neither has PITR
en.pricingNote: OrioleDB on every plan at standard Postgres pricing; Multigres for paid plans by invitation, free during the alpha

items.title: Mistral Large 4 بقى open weights: موديل 1T parameter
items.summary: Mistral نزّلت أوزان Mistral Large 4، موديل MoE بحوالي 1T parameter وحوالي 52B active، بيعمل instruct وreasoning ويقبل صور. الرخصة MIT معدّلة: مجاني للاستخدام والـ fine-tuning والتجاري، ما عدا مزوّدي Model-as-a-Service. سعر الـ API 0.70 دولار للمليون input و2.10 للمليون output.

items.about:
Mistral Large 4 موديل hybrid بيجمع instruct وreasoning، ويقبل input متعدد الوسائط. اتعرض كـ preview بدري في أكتوبر، ودلوقتي أوزانه متاحة على Hugging Face باسم Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B، ومعاه نسخة NVFP4 من mistralai، ونسخ GGUF وFP8 من Unsloth.

الرخصة اسمها Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license، وهي MIT معدّلة: تقدر تستخدمه وتعمله fine-tune وتستخدمه تجارياً، بس مزوّدي Model-as-a-Service محتاجين رخصة تجارية.

en.title: Ghostty 1.4: a ghostty +ssh command, scrollback compression, and the end of Ubuntu 24.04 support
en.summary: Ghostty 1.4 shipped on October 27. It adds a ghostty +ssh command that installs terminfo on the server before connecting, compression of idle scrollback that cuts memory by 70 to 90%, and full Kitty graphics support. On Linux it now needs GTK 4.18 and libadwaita 1.7, so Ubuntu 24.04 LTS isn't supported except through Flatpak.
en.why: If you SSH into Linux servers from Ghostty, ghostty +ssh fixes color and TERM issues. Before updating on Ubuntu 24.04, know that you'll need Flatpak or should stay on 1.3.
en.about:
ghostty +ssh wraps ssh: it installs Ghostty's terminfo on the server so TERM can be xterm-ghostty, forwards COLORTERM and TERM_PROGRAM, and falls back to xterm-256color if the install fails. Installs are cached per host and port, and the release notes suggest alias ssh='ghostty +ssh --'.

Idle off-screen scrollback is now compressed, and the project says memory drops by 70 to 90% for typical text on macOS and 64-bit Linux, and the default scrollback limit is now 50 MB instead of 10. Kitty graphics gain animation and relative placements, and there is support for the Kitty clipboard protocol (OSC 5522) and a new EGL renderer on GTK.

Breaking changes: copy-on-select now takes none, primary, clipboard or both, and clipboard now copies to the system clipboard only, so use both for the old behavior. On macOS the default is now none. GTK tab and prompt shortcuts changed, and scrollback-limit was renamed to scrollback-limit-bytes (the old name still works).

On Linux: it needs GTK 4.18 and libadwaita 1.7 (previously 4.14 and 1.5), and the release notes state plainly that Ubuntu 24.04 LTS doesn't meet that. The workaround is an older version or Flatpak.

en.title: Elephant-Goldfish Model: a Google plugin for writing specs and reviewing them with context-free subagents
en.summary: EGM is an open source plugin from Google that it says thousands of its engineers use. An agent with project context (Elephant) drafts the spec, subagents without the conversation's context (Goldfish) review it to expose unstated assumptions, and you approve before any code. It works in Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity.
en.why: Before you build a new ERP module, like an approvals system or webhooks, run /egm:egm-brainstorm, then egm-draft and egm-review, so you have a reviewed design before Claude Code writes a line.
en.about:
The idea is that a reviewer who holds the whole conversation lets through the same assumptions the spec was written with. So EGM separates the roles: Elephant holds the project context, requirements and earlier decisions and drafts the spec, while Goldfish reviewers see only the document and the sources it references, without the conversation. You resolve the trade-offs and approve.

The steps: egm-brainstorm discusses the idea and saves the direction in concepts_brief.md, egm-draft turns it into design_draft.md section by section and waits for your feedback, and egm-review has fresh reviewers check the design, its clarity, its fit with the code and the implementation plan. There are other skills like egm-review-loop and egm-drift-report.

In Claude Code the commands are prefixed with /egm:. Review needs a session that can create fresh subagents, and if it can't, EGM stops the review. The README says it doesn't replace tests or your judgment, and you don't need it for small, clear bug fixes. The license is Apache 2.0.

en.summary: tstack is a set of skills Theo (t3dotgg) published and uses daily, working in Claude Code and Codex. Some skills depend on others: full-send needs sol-loop, file-pr and babysit-pr, so install them together. council and sol-loop need a harness that can run models from other providers. The license is MIT.

items.summary: NVIDIA نزّلت يوم 28 أكتوبر Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe، موديل كلام بأوزان مفتوحة حوالي 30B parameter وحوالي 4B active. checkpoint واحد بيعمل transcription لـ 40 لغة، وترجمة بين الإنجليزي و31 لغة، وتحديد المتكلمين لحد 8 أشخاص، وأسئلة على الصوت بالإنجليزي. بيشتغل على تسجيلات لحد ساعة تقريباً، مش live.
items.why: لو بتعمل subtitles أو دبلجة لفيديوهاتك، ده بديل لـ Whisper بيحدد مين بيتكلم في نفس الخطوة. تقدر تجربه على endpoint مستضاف قبل ما تفكر تشغّله بنفسك، وراجع الرخصة ودعم العربي في الـ model card.
items.about:
الموديل بيجمع speech encoder مع language model من نوع hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE، وبيتوجّه بالـ prompt. checkpoint واحد بيغطي: transcription في 40 لغة، وترجمة من وإلى الإنجليزي مع 31 لغة، وتحديد المتكلمين في 13 لغة لحد 8 أشخاص، وأسئلة وأجوبة على الصوت بالإنجليزي.

بيشتغل على صوت مسجّل بس، مش streaming، ولتسجيلات لحد ساعة تقريباً. تقدر تشغّله بنفسك بـ vLLM أو SGLang-Omni، أو تستخدمه مستضاف على Baseten وDeepInfra وSimplismart. فيه نسخ FP8 وNVFP4 على Hugging Face.

ومعاه Granary v2، dataset فيها حوالي 463 ألف ساعة في 48 لغة بدل 25 في v1، والصوت الأصلي بيتحمّل من كل مصدر برخصته. المقال ما ذكرش رخصة الموديل، فراجع الـ model card قبل ما تعتمد عليه.

تسجيلات لحد ساعة، مش live

en.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe: an open-weight speech model for 40 languages
en.summary: On October 28 NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open-weight speech model with about 30B parameters and about 4B active. One checkpoint does transcription in 40 languages, translation between English and 31 languages, speaker attribution for up to 8 people, and English audio Q&A. It works on recordings up to about an hour, not live.
en.why: If you make subtitles or dubs for your videos, this is an alternative to Whisper that identifies who's speaking in the same pass. Try it on a hosted endpoint before thinking about running it yourself, and check the license and Arabic support on the model card.
en.about:
The model combines a speech encoder with a hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE language model, and it's steered by prompts. One checkpoint covers: transcription in 40 languages, translation to and from English with 31 languages, speaker attribution in 13 languages for up to 8 people, and question answering over English audio.

It works on recorded audio only, not streaming, for recordings up to about an hour. You can run it yourself with vLLM or SGLang-Omni, or use it hosted on Baseten, DeepInfra and Simplismart. FP8 and NVFP4 versions are on Hugging Face.

It comes with Granary v2, a dataset of about 463,000 hours across 48 languages, up from 25 in v1, with the source audio downloaded from each corpus under its own license. The article doesn't state the model's license, so check the model card before relying on it.
features: Transcription in 40 languages
Translation between English and 31 languages
Speaker attribution for up to 8 people
Recordings up to an hour, not live
Hosted endpoints on Baseten, DeepInfra and Simplismart
en.pricingNote: Open weights; the license isn't stated in the article, so check the model card

items.title: ComfyUI 0.43: textures PBR بتتكرر من صورة، ودبلجة VEED، وFibo 2.0
items.summary: ComfyUI 0.43.0 نزل يوم 27 أكتوبر و0.43.1 يوم 28. فيه Patina nodes بتطلع textures PBR بتتكرر بسلاسة (basecolor وnormal وroughness وmetalness وheight) من صورة أو نص، وnode لـ VEED Dubbing بيترجم كلام الفيديو ويظبط حركة الشفايف، وFibo 2.0 مفتوح المصدر لتوليد وتعديل الصور، ودعم ACEScg.
items.why: لو بتجرب توليد الصور على جهازك بـ ComfyUI، Fibo 2.0 موديل مفتوح جديد تجربه. وVEED Dubbing ممكن يدبلج فيديو جوه نفس الـ workflow، بس ده partner node مدفوع.
items.about:
في 0.43.1: Patina texture nodes بتطلع مجموعة materials PBR بتتكرر من غير فواصل، فيها basecolor وnormal وroughness وmetalness وheight، من صورة أو من prompt. ونود VEED Dubbing بيترجم الكلام في الفيديو ويعيد مزامنة الشفايف.

في 0.43.0: Fibo 2.0 مفتوح المصدر لتوليد الصور من نص وتعديلها، وLoRAs لتعديل الصور بـ MOSS-Image، ودعم color space بتاع ACEScg، وnodes جديدة زي Branch وPad Image. وفيه partner nodes لـ PixVerse V6 Max وMeshy T2.5 وIdeogram Vector اللي بيطلع SVG.

البرنامج الأساسي مفتوح المصدر ومجاني، بس الـ partner nodes زي VEED وPixVerse وIdeogram بتنادي APIs مدفوعة.
features: Patina: textures PBR بتتكرر من صورة أو نص
VEED Dubbing: ترجمة ومزامنة شفايف
Fibo 2.0 مفتوح لتوليد وتعديل الصور
دعم ACEScg
Ideogram Vector بيطلع SVG

en.title: ComfyUI 0.43: tiling PBR textures from a photo, VEED dubbing and Fibo 2.0
en.summary: ComfyUI 0.43.0 shipped on October 27 and 0.43.1 on October 28. They add Patina nodes that produce seamlessly tiling PBR textures (basecolor, normal, roughness, metalness and height) from a photo or text, a VEED Dubbing node that translates a video's speech and re-syncs the lips, open source Fibo 2.0 for image generation and editing, and ACEScg support.
en.why: If you experiment with image generation on your machine in ComfyUI, Fibo 2.0 is a new open model to try. VEED Dubbing can dub a video inside the same workflow, but it's a paid partner node.
en.about:
In 0.43.1: Patina texture nodes produce a seamlessly tiling PBR material set, with basecolor, normal, roughness, metalness and height, from a photo or a prompt. The VEED Dubbing node translates the speech in a video and re-syncs the lips.

In 0.43.0: open source Fibo 2.0 for text-to-image and editing, MOSS-Image edit LoRAs, ACEScg color space support, and new nodes like Branch and Pad Image. There are also partner nodes for PixVerse V6 Max, Meshy T2.5 and Ideogram Vector, which outputs SVG.

The core app is open source and free, but partner nodes like VEED, PixVerse and Ideogram call paid APIs.
features: Patina: tiling PBR textures from a photo or text
VEED Dubbing: translation and lip sync
Open Fibo 2.0 for image generation and editing
ACEScg support
Ideogram Vector outputs SVG
en.pricingNote: The app is open source; partner nodes are paid
